beats.say: Most job posts name Snowflake or Databricks.
Interviewers go past the brochure. They ask how it works, and what it costs.
beats.label: What they ask
beats.head: How it works, what it costs

beats.say: So learn each platform in one picture. Then learn how to choose.
beats.label: Track 12 · Snowflake and Databricks

check.prompt: Two teams run queries on the same Snowflake data. How do you stop them from slowing each other down?
options: Give each team its own warehouse
check.why: Storage and compute are separate. Each warehouse is its own compute.

beats.say: First: Snowflake has three layers.
Storage holds the data. Virtual warehouses run the queries. A services layer plans and secures.
beats.label: Three layers

beats.say: Storage and compute are separate. So each team can have its own warehouse.
beats.label: The big idea
beats.head: Storage and compute are separate

beats.say: Data sits in small blocks called micro-partitions. Each one knows its minimum and maximum.
beats.label: Micro-partitions
beats.head: Small blocks with min and max

beats.say: A good filter lets Snowflake skip most blocks. That is pruning.
beats.label: Pruning
beats.head: Skip most of the blocks

beats.say: Second: three Snowflake features they ask about.
Time travel reads a table as it was, some hours or days ago.
beats.label: Time travel
beats.head: Read the table as it was

beats.say: A clone copies a table in seconds. It shares the same blocks, so it costs nothing at first.
beats.label: Zero-copy clone
beats.head: A copy that shares the blocks

beats.say: And Snowpipe loads new files as they land, with no schedule.
beats.label: Snowpipe
beats.head: Load files as they land

options: It governs access to data in one place
check.why: Unity Catalog holds the grants, the lineage and the names for every workspace.

beats.say: Third: Databricks is a lakehouse.
Your data stays as Delta tables, in your own cloud storage.
beats.label: Storage
beats.head: Delta tables in your storage

beats.say: Spark clusters and SQL warehouses run on top of it.
beats.label: Compute
beats.head: Spark and SQL on top

beats.say: And Unity Catalog governs it all: names, grants, and lineage, in one place.
beats.label: Governance
beats.head: Unity Catalog: one place for access

beats.say: Last: which one do you pick?
Mostly SQL and analysts? Snowflake is simple to run.
beats.label: SQL first
beats.head: SQL teams: Snowflake

beats.say: Heavy Spark, streaming, or machine learning? Databricks fits better.
beats.label: Engineering first
beats.head: Spark and ML: Databricks

beats.say: In the interview, give one recommendation. Then say its trade-off.
beats.label: The senior answer
beats.head: Recommend, then give the trade-off

beats.say: Quick recap of the two platforms.
Snowflake separates storage and compute. Databricks is Delta plus Spark. And always name the trade-off.
beats.label: Snowflake and Databricks
